integrity: Analytic proof of all parameter ranges uses an exact Zak multiplier, strict inequalities, and asymptotic expansions; finite checker is supplemental.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-translation lattices with integer frequency oversampling q>=2. Width limits are at fixed q. No noninteger-density frame-bound formula and no historical uniqueness claim; an older Janssen article could not be read in full.
title: Exact integer-oversampling Gabor frame bounds for the Poisson window
